correctness.rationale: At beta=alpha=pi/2 and omega=0 the original Jüttner–Martens directed system becomes phi_dot=D cos(phi), D_dot=-eps(D+a sin(phi)), S_dot=eps(1-S). Each cos-sign semicircle is invariant; q=artanh(sin phi) gives qdot=D and qddot+eps qdot+eps a tanh(q)=0. Coercive H=D²/2+eps a log cosh(q), Hdot=-eps D² and LaSalle imply global locking and exact integrated asymmetry dissipation D0²/(2eps)-a log|cos phi0|. Variation of constants until q hits a fixed R gives T_R=|q0|/a+O(1), uniformly when D0 is bounded. Linear discriminant eps(eps-4a) gives oscillatory-to-real eigenvalue change. Independent solve_ivp check at a=.8,eps=1.3,q0=8,D0=.4 reached q=1 around t=10.009 and conserved energy budget to numerical tolerance; this finite check does not prove all basins.
